meaning: These connect statements set the venous-return topology below the vertebral venous system: the hydrostatic block Hs_Rvvs feeds both the transverse path (Rt) and the epidural path (Hs_Revp), the internal/external vertebral plexus resistances rejoin at the azygos branch, and the loop closes back onto the systemic Rsys/Csys node. It fixes which collateral routes carry flow when jugular outflow is impeded, and where gravity columns sit.

could_move.what: Flow split between jugular and vertebral/epidural collaterals during jugular compression
Postural and hydrostatic-height sweeps, since the Hs_ blocks sit on these branches
Abdominal pressure ramp/sine responses that load the epidural-azygos route
Fitted parameter values, because the fit sees a different network

expectation: Unknown in sign and size. A topology edit here can change collateral flow split and downstream pressures a lot, and can also change whether the system assembles or solves at all. I cannot tell from this context.

check.why: Re-solves a single fitted case against stored targets, so an assembly error or a shifted residual shows up without paying for a full re-fit.
